correctness.rationale: For any fixed kappa>1 and 0<eta<=1, both normalized gradient descent rays intersect at the explicit feasible positive parameters t=(epsilon*kappa+epsilon+kappa-1)/(2 epsilon kappa), s=(epsilon+kappa-1)/(epsilon kappa). With common damping the pair distance contracts by 1-eta; epsilon times the common intersection tends to (-(kappa-1)/kappa,-(kappa-1)), so both objectives scale as eta^2(kappa-1)^2(kappa+kappa^-2)/(2epsilon^2) from bounded initial points. For kappa=2, eta=c epsilon gives limiting best-objective minimum of two exact quadratics and unique upper safe threshold (20+2sqrt(19))/9; determinant identity gives 1-cos(theta)~2epsilon^2/25. Direct independent symbolic/rational check confirmed intersection, positivity, two limit quadratics, angle scaling and c*. This is one raw step, not behavior of safeguarded full method.
